description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Filter::NumberSuffix' which implements a template filter to display numbers with their three most significant digits, appending suffixes like 'K' or 'M' for thousands or millions.

classes.name: Coocook::Filter::NumberSuffix
classes.description: A Perl package implementing a template filter to format numbers with suffixes.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Formats a number to have three significant digits and appends a suffix ('K' or 'M') if applicable.
